board: TowerPro MG996R servo (3-wire lead, JR/Futaba S plug: brown GND, red V+, orange signal)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico (spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). The servo is modelled as the datasheet describes it: 50 Hz pulses, 1.5 ms centre, about 120 degrees of travel (1.0-2.0 ms = 0-120 deg). The supply is limited to TowerPro's 4.8-6.6 V. The example turns it to 30 then 90 degrees.
